lyrics: neera pOkkaru biDE bEnninOLagE bahu - bhAra pOTHEnEndhu biDHaru bidEnu
kOrEya masEyutha kEsaru kONDaru bidE - ghOra roopava thALi jari jarisalu nAnu
Charanam 2,3 in same tune as Charanam 1
thirukanEndharu biDE thiLidhu thAya kOraLa - tharikanEndharu ninna nA biDEnu
pOrEya pithana vAkya kAda sEralu biDE - dhuruLa maduvinali dhumukidharEyu nAnu
kadu baTHalAgi yEnna kaili kAsillEndharu - OdanE hayavEri Odidharu biDEnu
pOdaviyOLagE namma purandhara viTTalana - kaDEhAyisuva bAra ninna dhadhakE nAnu
